what: First loader — over a background-color film, seven fireflies are born one at a time at 2.185s intervals (fading in over 1.9s). They drift slowly around the film center (47% horizontal, 56% from the bottom) within 28.5% of the screen height, tremble like wingbeats, and each blinks at .37~.57Hz (on for 45% of the period — peak at 28%, residual glow .07~.12 at rest). A yellow core (the accent color turned yellow) and a surrounding glow overlap. Below are the wordmark and the loaded share (%). Once all page images and videos are loaded (or on the fx:ready event), and at least .62s has passed from the start, the film lifts upward over .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) — after 6.5s it lifts regardless

options.max: After this length (seconds) passes, it just walks, default 6.5
options.wait: If event, it keeps waiting even after all images are loaded and lifts only on receiving the fx:ready event (e.g. after a 3D scene is fully built)
options.[data-fx-part=pct]: Place for the fetched share count
options.--fx-bg · --fx-core · --fx-halo: (css variable) film color · firefly core · surrounding glow

from.where: index.html .rw-loader (original z-70 mask’s WebGL2 fireflies — totalTarget 7 · interval mix(1.1,4.2,.35) · maxDrift .285 · baseRadius .01 · pulse .465, center (.4715,.5648), lift yPercent -100 .9s press, minimum 620ms, 6500ms failsafe)

note: Fires fx:open when it starts to lift and fx:done when fully lifted. The original counts progress as three load 55% + video download 45% — pages that build a scene set wait: event and fire fx:ready after everything is built
